name: US trade balance ($mn)
description: Goods and services, balance of payments basis, monthly, seasonally adjusted.

origin.dataset: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services (FT-900)

migration.note: The monthly balance of the FT-900 release, which the Census Bureau compiles with the Bureau of Economic Analysis; read from the Census Bureau's flat file, which gives the balance from January 1996. v1 took the same figure from FRED (BOPGSTB). The quarterly balance of the international transactions accounts is trade_q.
